mail_outbox_due_idx.name: mail_outbox_due_idx
mail_outbox_due_idx.where: "mail_outbox"."sent_at" is null and "mail_outbox"."failed_at" is null and "mail_outbox"."dropped_at" is null

mail_outbox_pending_unique.name: mail_outbox_pending_unique
mail_outbox_pending_unique.where: "mail_outbox"."sent_at" is null and "mail_outbox"."failed_at" is null and "mail_outbox"."dropped_at" is null

contacts_user_unique.name: contacts_user_unique
contacts_user_unique.where: "contacts"."deleted_at" is null and "contacts"."user_id" is not null

contacts_email_unique.name: contacts_email_unique
contacts_email_unique.where: "contacts"."deleted_at" is null and "contacts"."email" is not null

folders_named.name: folders_named
folders_named.value: ("folders"."parent_id" is null and "folders"."organization_id" is not null and "folders"."name" is null) or "folders"."name" is not null

activities_next_step_idx.name: activities_next_step_idx
activities_next_step_idx.where: "activities"."next_step_text" is not null and "activities"."next_step_done_at" is null and "activities"."deleted_at" is null
